name: qwen3.7-flash
description: The Qwen3.7 native vision-language Flash model series delivers comprehensive improvements in multimodal understanding and agentic execution over Qwen3.6-Flash. It features stronger core multimodal capabilities and enhanced recognition across a wide range of objects and scenarios, alongside major advances in real-world perception and spatial intelligence. Its performance in multimodal agent scenarios—including Search Agents and CI Agents—has been significantly upgraded, with more reliable end-to-end task execution. Multimodal coding has also been optimized for a smoother vibe coding experience.
zhDescription: Qwen3.7原生视觉语言系列Flash模型，相较3.6-Flash全面提升多模态理解与Agent执行能力。重点强化多模态基础能力、万物识别能力更强，真实世界感知与空间智能进一步提升，Search Agent、CI Agent等多模态Agent场景能力显著升级、端到端任务执行更稳定，多模态Coding能力优化、vibe coding 体验更加流畅。
